svg.title: The first three merges on the TOY genes
svg.desc: Schematic after Compeau & Pevzner, Chapter 8, Figure 8.24, drawn from the lab's TOY data with the lab's reference code and the lab's average distance in place of the book's minimum distance. Three rows. In each, a matrix of distances between the current clusters has its smallest entry in orange, and the tree so far is drawn beside it. Row 1: ten single genes; the smallest distance, 0.7, is between g3 and g5, which merge. Row 2: nine clusters; the smallest, 0.9, is between g2 and g4. Row 3: eight clusters; the smallest, 1.0, is between g8 and the cluster of g3 and g5.
svg.text: The smallest distance, 0.7, is between g3​ and g5​: merge them
The smallest distance, 0.9, is between g2​ and g4​: merge them
The smallest distance, 1.0, is between g8​ and {g3​, g5​}: merge them
Distances between clusters are average distances, as in the lab's hierarchical_clustering.
